title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
abstract: arXiv:2610.29968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. translated_title: CulturalRiddles：一个多文化谜语基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型不断扩大其语言覆盖范围，评估它们对多元文化的理解和表达能力变得越来越重要。然而，许多基准测试仍然以英语为中心，文化覆盖有限，并且更侧重于事实性知识而非其在现实文化语境中的应用。我们提出了CulturalRiddles，这是一个完全由人类通过社区参与式努力创作的原创、植根于文化的谜语基准，涵盖62种文化（45个国家、51种语言）。这些谜语深深植根于各自的文化，需要溯因推理和组合推理能力，以及详细的事实和社会知识、语言技能以及对文化特定关联的理解。我们使用自动评估和大规模人工评估对28个LLM配置进行了基准测试。即使是前沿模型，在某些社区中的准确率也最高仅达到22%。
tldr: CulturalRiddles是一个涵盖62种文化、完全由人类创作的谜语基准测试，用于评估大语言模型的跨文化理解与推理能力，结果表明即使是前沿模型在某些社区中的准确率也最高仅达22%。
en_tdlr: CulturalRiddles is a fully human-created riddle benchmark spanning 62 cultures that evaluates LLMs' cross-cultural understanding and abductive reasoning, revealing that even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities.
